phase: prompt-8 learned-gate integration into joint policy (end-to-end validation)

learned_gate_sweep.parallelization: 18 processes = 6 thresholds x 3 seeds; single seed per process

integration_semantics.joint_learned_gate: identical to joint_new_verify_stop in disease model, answer channel, BeliefTracker misreport gate (HistoryReliabilityMisreportGate), AskNew strategy, stop condition, re-ask channel, and cost/budget; the ONLY change is VerifyOld reliability scoring, which uses saved learned gate probability x leave-one-out diagnostic influence instead of the retrospective error probability.
integration_semantics.learned_risk_i: learned gate probability saved at answer arrival, computed BEFORE the answer enters the tracker using then-visible history and belief
integration_semantics.no_future_leakage: gate score never reads noise_rate, latent state, true report mode, true disease, actual wrongness, or future answers
integration_semantics.belief_tracker_gate_unchanged: HistoryReliabilityMisreportGate is NOT replaced (so disease posterior is unaffected)

fixes_this_phase: rank_actions/choose_action accept report_risks and substitute saved learned risk for retrospective error_probability in VerifyOld scoring and the stop reliability check
run_reliability_aware_dialogue saves learned risk at answer arrival, before tracker.update
run_reliability_experiment accepts learned_verification_gate and a joint_learned_gate strategy
CLI adds --learned-verification-gate <json> and the joint_learned_gate strategy choice
test_split_policy: NOT accessed in this phase (inputs are release_validate_patients.zip only)
